H01.description: Adds a comment explaining why the fallback page needs a charset declaration; no behaviour change by itself (the fix is H02).

H02.description: The generated fallback HTML has no <meta charset>, so browsers may decode it with a legacy encoding and corrupt the inlined non-ASCII HMR runtime script.

I01.description: Adds support for subpath import keys containing multiple '#'; this is unrelated to the change's fallback-HTML behaviour, and nothing shown ties it to the head code under review.

I02.description: Adds convertExternalRequire for the ssr webworker target; this is an unrelated later feature fix, and nothing shown ties it to the head code under review.

I03.description: Passes isBundled to the resolver for bundled-dev builtin named imports; this is unrelated to the head change, and nothing shown ties it to the head code.
